What's New in 4.9

Highlights

  • DeepSeek workflows — Choose DeepSeek models for AI workflows.
  • Chat suggestions — Get next-message suggestions without interrupting your draft.
  • Shared Notes — Create and organize Markdown notes in a full-page editor and cross-project library.
  • Compact updates — Download updates from one icon in the bottom navigation rail, then restart Hive now or later.

Features

  • Unify window navigation and contextual sidebars.
  • Confirm local changes before moving threads.
  • Safely copy local changes before thread moves.
  • Stop transcribe and send recordings in one click.
  • Show measured dictation waveform and pending states.
  • Publish measured dictation waveform levels.

Improvements

  • Resolve activity store ownership once per pass.
  • Replace process probes with scoped activity recovery.
  • Preserve the runtime provider across presentation changes.
  • Reuse discovery for live chat reconnects.
  • Reuse recent conversations when switching threads.
  • Bound navigation updates to affected rows.

Bug Fixes

  • Close provider menu after selection.
  • Load workflow models when opening the editor.
  • Anchor workflow model picker suggestions.
  • Prevent recursive native shortcut dispatch.
  • Render unread dots at a whole-pixel size.
  • Add discoverable new chat action.

Full release notes: https://github.com/Ajanth/hive-public/releases/tag/v4.9
